summary: PlugNPiN is a Docker-based utility that automates local network configuration by scraping container labels. It generates corresponding DNS entries in Pi-Hole or AdGuard Home alongside proxy hosts within Nginx Proxy Manager.
goodFor: Home lab operators running Docker who want to automate the process of creating local DNS records and reverse proxy routing without manual intervention.
watchOut: The project has a relatively small community footprint and a slowing development pace, which may impact long-term maintenance and bug fixes.
deployNotes: As a Docker container, it typically requires network access to your DNS sinkhole and proxy manager APIs, along with persistent storage if state is retained.
